emp.title: Employee master data
emp.desc: The live employee register. Every other record links here by Employee ID.

f.help: Leave blank to set 6 months from joining

profile.title: Employee profiles
profile.desc: Personal, emergency and statutory details for each employee. Sensitive numbers are masked in lists and exports.

probation.title: Probation tracking
probation.desc: Every employee on probation, their end date and the outcome. Overdue when the end date passes without a decision.

docs.title: Employee documents
docs.desc: ID proofs, certificates and letters for each employee, with verification and expiry.

exit.title: Employee exit management
exit.desc: Resignations and exits from notice to final settlement. Completing an exit marks the employee as Exited.

appraisal.title: Appraisal tracker
appraisal.desc: Where each employee is in the appraisal cycle. Overdue when the review due date passes.

reviews.title: Employee performance reviews
reviews.desc: Written reviews with goals, strengths and areas to improve.

probrev.title: Probation reviews
probrev.desc: Assessment at the end of probation. A completed review with “Confirm” makes the employee Active and closes their probation record.

increments.title: Increment history
increments.desc: Every pay change for each employee. Approved salary revisions in Payroll are added here automatically.

recog.title: Employee recognition
recog.desc: Awards and spot recognition, from nomination to award.

assets2.title: Laptop & asset management
assets2.desc: Company laptops and equipment, who has them, and their condition.

cards.title: Access card tracker
cards.desc: Office access cards: who holds them, validity and returns.

facilities.title: Office facilities
facilities.desc: Maintenance and facility requests for the office, with owners and due dates.

vendors.title: Vendor management
vendors.desc: Office and HR vendors with contracts and renewal dates.

manpower.title: Manpower requirements
manpower.desc: Approved headcount to hire against. Candidates are tracked against these requirements.

cands.title: Candidate tracker
cands.desc: Every applicant and their stage. “Convert to employee” creates their Employee ID and sets up onboarding.

interviews2.title: Interview scheduling
interviews2.desc: Interview rounds with panel, time, feedback and result.

offers2.title: Offer letters
offers2.desc: Offers from draft to acceptance. Overdue when the offer passes its valid-till date unanswered.

joining.title: Joining formalities
joining.desc: Day-one paperwork and setup for each new joiner. Created automatically when a candidate is converted.

onboard2.title: Onboarding checklist
onboard2.desc: Tasks to settle each new joiner in. Use “Add standard checklist” to create the usual 8 tasks in one step.

interns.title: Internship management
interns.desc: Interns, mentors, projects and evaluations. “Convert to employee” moves a good intern into the employee register.

att.title: Daily attendance
att.desc: One entry per employee per day. Hours are worked out from in and out times.

logs.title: Login & logout tracking
logs.desc: Clock-in and clock-out times. Use “Log in / out now” to stamp the current time for an employee.

leaves2.title: Leave requests
leaves2.desc: Leave applications and approvals. Approved days count against Leave Balance.

wfh.title: Work from home tracker
wfh.desc: WFH requests checked against your Leave Policy: 1 day a month, requested at least 15 days ahead.

compoff.title: Comp-off tracker
compoff.desc: Compensatory days earned for working on a holiday or week off, and when they are used.

holidays2.title: Holiday calendar
holidays2.desc: Company holidays by location. The status updates itself as dates pass.

payroll2.title: Monthly payroll
payroll2.desc: One line per employee per month. Net pay is gross minus deductions.

structure.title: Salary structure
structure.desc: Monthly salary components for each employee. Monthly gross is the sum of earnings.

revisions.title: Salary revision & appraisals
revisions.desc: Pay revisions from appraisals. Approving one adds it to the employee’s Increment History.

payslips2.title: Payslip records
payslips2.desc: Issued payslips by month, with acknowledgement.

pfesi.title: PF & ESI compliance
pfesi.desc: Monthly PF and ESI contributions and challans. Overdue after the due date.

statutory.title: Statutory compliance tracker
statutory.desc: All statutory filings and renewals with owners and due dates.

events.title: Company events
events.desc: Celebrations, offsites and festivals, with budget and turnout.

feedback.title: Employee feedback
feedback.desc: Suggestions and concerns from employees, with the action taken. Anonymous feedback hides the employee.

townhall.title: Town hall meetings
townhall.desc: Agenda, attendance, minutes and action items for each town hall.

training.title: Training & development
training.desc: Training programmes with trainer, dates, participants and cost.

posh.title: POSH training & committee
posh.desc: Internal Committee members and POSH training sessions. Complaints are not recorded here.

sectrain.title: Security & compliance training
sectrain.desc: Mandatory courses assigned to each employee, with due dates and scores.

handbook.title: Employee handbook
handbook.desc: Versions of the employee handbook. Publish a version, then send it for acknowledgement.

policies.title: HR policies
policies.desc: All HR policies with owners and review dates. Overdue when the review date passes.

acks.title: Policy acknowledgements
acks.desc: Who has acknowledged which policy. Use “Send to all employees” to create pending acknowledgements in one step.

officeexp.title: Office expenses
officeexp.desc: Company spend on rent, utilities, supplies and services, linked to vendors.

goals.title: Goals & KRAs
goals.desc: Goals for each employee and cycle. Weights for one cycle should add up to 100%.

checkins.title: Check-ins
checkins.desc: Regular one-to-one conversations between employees and managers.

f.help: Filled from master data if left blank

pips.title: Improvement plans
pips.desc: Performance improvement plans. Confidential: visible only to HR Admin, the assigned HR partner, the manager, and the employee once shared.

promos.title: Promotion nominations
promos.desc: Promotions from nomination to effect. Current designation, grade and pay are read from master data and Salary structure.

idps.title: Career plans
idps.desc: Individual development plans: target role, skills to build and progress.

succession.title: Succession planning
succession.desc: Successors for critical roles and how ready they are. Restricted to HR Admin and Leadership.

surveys.title: Pulse surveys
surveys.desc: Short anonymous surveys. Every survey asks the eNPS question (0–10) plus your statements rated 1–5.

defaults.stmts:
I have the tools and resources to do my job well
My manager supports my growth
I feel recognised for good work
I understand how my work contributes to company goals
I see myself working here in two years

licences.title: Licences & registrations
licences.desc: Company registrations and licences with renewal dates.

actions.title: HR actions & reminders
actions.desc: One to-do list for HR. Most actions are created automatically from dates in other modules and close themselves when resolved.
